descr: Gemini 3.6 Flash vs Kimi K3: about even performance with Kimi slightly ahead in coding.
risposta: The two models are essentially tied. Their chat scores differ by only five points, which is too close to call. Kimi K3 has a small edge in coding, but overall they perform about the same.
dimensioni: Gemini 3.6 Flash does not disclose its model size, so the download size is unknown. Kimi K3 weighs 2779.9 B in total, with 104.6 B active, and requires about 1686 GB to download in 4-bit format.
velocita: Both models need to run online; none of the listed home GPUs can fit the model weights. RTX 3090, RTX 4090, RTX 5090, RX 7900 XTX, Mac M4 Max 128 GB, and Ryzen AI Max+ 395 128 GB all report "online only" for Gemini 3.6 Flash and "does not fit" for Kimi K3.
gratisA: Gemini 3.6 Flash can be accessed for free through Google’s Gemini API free tier. The model is under a proprietary license and does not have open weights.
gratisB: Kimi K3 is available for free download and can be run at home under the Kimi K3 license. Its weights are open, allowing local execution.
sceglieA: Pick Gemini 3.6 Flash if you prefer a cloud-based solution with a simple free API and do not need to host the model yourself. It is suitable for users who want quick access without managing large files.
sceglieB: Pick Kimi K3 when you want open weights and the ability to run the model locally. It is a good fit for hobbyists who can allocate the required storage and prefer full control over the model.

categorie.Chat: In the Chat category the scores are 1483 for Gemini 3.6 Flash and 1488 for Kimi K3, making the results about even.
categorie.Coding: For Coding, Kimi K3 scores 1659 while Gemini 3.6 Flash scores 1538, giving Kimi a clear advantage.
